name: delivery-meeple-choice-v1
description: ⭐ DECOMPOSITION ARM 2 OF 3 (14/09/2026): THE DELIVERY MEEPLE PLUS THE SPACE CHOICE, on the reference-v18 game. Its CONTROL for the choice is overlays/delivery-meeple-no-choice-v1.overlay.json, from which it differs in ONE leaf, rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice true (a delivery names either free space, so a first arrival may take the 3 VP space and its meeple and leave the 6 VP); against overlays/pre-delivery-meeple-v1.overlay.json it is five leaves. The four meeple leaves are set at Dean's ruled values (deliveryMeepleSpace 1, meepleSpendTiming 'afterAction', meepleSpendPerTurn 1, meepleSpendDistinctColours false) and rules.turn.closingDrawPerCrate is pinned 0. ⛔ PASSENGERS, NAMED: startingMeeplesPerColour 0 and meepleAsCard false from the base; everything else is the shipped reference-v18 game. ⚠️ READ a23's first-delivery share as a reading about the bots as much as the rule: the pricer weighs 6 VP well above 3 VP and a meeple. The third sibling is overlays/closing-draw-only-v1.overlay.json. ⚠️ HOW TO RUN IT: --overlay= with --watchlist, never --sweep=, and always --n=1580 (4,820 games, five mirrors), paired on identical reference-v18 seeds. A bare --watchlist is a 1,580-game pilot and must not be quoted beside a real run. Since 16/09/2026 the balloons, the Aerodrome, the Village Store, the closing draw and the wild substitution are deleted from the engine, so this overlay no longer replays the game it was recorded on. Its pins for the closing draw were removed with them.
